chains.name: BackWerk
chains.notes: BackWerk publishes average nutrition per 100 g plus 'Verkaufsgewicht' (sales weight) on each product page; per-serving values computed as per100g × Verkaufsgewicht / 100 (computedFromPer100g). No fiber published. Hot drinks (Kaffee Schwarz, Cappuccino, Latte Macchiato etc.) only have per-100 g values without a serving size and bottled drinks have no values, so no drinks are included. Dropped: Baguettino Schnitzel (page description names Gouda/Putenschinken/Ei but its allergen list has only Senf, Weizen – inconsistent page), Börekstange Hähnchenkebab (site lists 287 g carbs per 100 g – obvious data error) and Hot Sandwich Chicken Kebab (published macros 19 % below published kcal). lactose-free is set only where the product page's allergen list contains no Milch. Not all products are sold in every store ('Die Produkte können je nach Land und Region variieren').

chains.name: Burger King
chains.sourceTitle: Burger King Deutschland – Lebensmittelinformationen inkl. Allergenen und Nährwerte
chains.notes: Values 'pro Portion' as shown in the 'Lebensmittelinformationen inkl. Allergenen und Nährwerte' panel of each burgerking.de menu item (spot-checked: Whopper 282 g, 613 kcal). burgerking.de loads these from Burger King's own Sanity dataset prod_bk_de (the 'nutrition' object of the à-la-carte item); that JSON was read directly. Items chosen from the live burgerking.de/menu, excluding the 'Neu & Limitiert' section. Breakfast items are from the 'Frühstück' section. Drink servingG are ml. pork tag on King Toasty Bacon Egg follows the brief's bacon rule; meat type not stated by BK.

chains.name: dean&david
chains.notes: Values per Portion from the official German nutrition PDF 'Nährwerte dean&david', Stand September 2026 (columns per 100 g/ml and per Portion; per-Portion values used). Portion weights are not printed, so servingG is omitted (except the 0,4 l smoothie). Salads are listed WITHOUT dressing and bread – add a dressing (e.g. Caesar Dressing) and Brot items separately. Bowls include base and sauce; curries include rice. No fiber published. Wraps/Sandwiches named with a type suffix here to disambiguate (PDF lists 'Caesar Chicken' under both Salads and Wraps; 'Chicken Avocado' under Sandwiches; 'Pesto Chicken' under Flatbreads; 'Green Machine' under Smoothies). Seasonal (Pumpkin Spice) and 'Additional Specials (nur in teilnehmenden Stores)' items excluded. dean&david has no separate breakfast menu in the PDF. 'Kaffee' and 'Iced Coffee' are listed with 0 kcal and 0 macros. No lactose-free tags set (allergen PDF not cross-checked).

chains.name: Five Guys
chains.notes: Values 'Werte pro Portion' from Five Guys Deutschland's official PDF 'Nährwertangaben – Five Guys Deutschland' (FGDE 15/06/2026), linked from fiveguys.de. Five Guys DE does NOT publish complete burgers or hot dogs, only components per portion (Rindfleisch-Burgerpatty 195 kcal / 18 g protein, Burger-Brötchen 243 kcal, Käse 70 kcal, Bacon 78 kcal, toppings). Burgers were not composed from parts, so they are missing; no serving weights and no drinks are published. Fries are 'frittiert in Erdnussöl' (ingredients: Kartoffeln, Erdnussöl, Salz). Milkshake = base only, without mix-ins. 'Burger im Salat Wrap' was skipped because its row fails the energy check (columns look shifted).

chains.name: KFC
chains.notes: Values '*pro Portion' from KFC Deutschland's official PDF 'Zusatzinformationen zu zubereiteten Produkten' (pages 7–25, footer 'SEPTEMBER 2026'), linked from kfc.de as 'Detaillierte Produktinformationen'. kfc.de product pages show no numbers. The PDF publishes no fibre, so fibre is omitted. Items cross-checked against the live kfc.de/menu. Names follow kfc.de menu wording; PDF names: 'TWISTER®/CRISPY TWISTER®' (Crispy Twister), 'VEGGIE TWISTER®' (Crispy Veggie Twister), 'DOUBLE COLONEL BURGER' (Double Colonel Original Burger), 'PEPSI ZERO ZUCKER 500 ml' (Pepsi Zero 0,5 l). Chicken pieces, Crispys and Original Bites are per single piece as published. Salads exclude dressing. Bacon at KFC DE is pork belly (official ingredients). Original chicken breading contains milk powder, so nothing is tagged lactose-free. Coca-Cola is also in the PDF, but the kfc.de menu sells Pepsi, so Pepsi is used.

chains.name: McDonald's
chains.notes: Values per portion as shown on each mcdonalds.com/de product page; the page loads them from McDonald's own itemDetails JSON (country=DE), which was read directly. All items are flagged 'Core Item' there. Names without ® and without internal item codes. Drinks: McDonald's states the 0,5 l Coca-Cola Zero Sugar and water as 543 g (servingG is that published weight); Orangensaft is published as 0,25 L (servingG 250 = ml). lactose-free only where the official allergen list for the item names no milk. McChicken and Fish Filet Classic also appear in the 'Highlights' category; they are flagged Core Item, but a reviewer may want to confirm they are permanent. The site blocks plain curl (Akamai 403); data was read in a normal browser session.

chains.name: Starbucks
chains.notes: Values per piece (Food PDF, column "pro Stk", with "Gewicht pro Portion") and per cup size (Getränke Nährwerte PDF) as published by Starbucks Deutschland, PDFs dated 10.09.2026. Drink sizes (Short/Tall/Grande/Venti) are not given in ml in the PDF, so servingG is omitted for drinks. Drink values are for the standard recipe with the milk named in the item (Halbfettmilch = semi-skimmed). Fiber is listed separately (EU labelling; carbs exclude fiber). Fiber "n/a" in the PDF is omitted. Vegan/vegetarian tags from the PDF columns "Vegan"/"Vegetarisch". Seasonal autumn promo items deliberately left out. Protein Joghurt is marked "kann bei übermäßigem Verzehr abführend wirken" in the PDF.

chains.name: Subway
chains.notes: Values 'Werte pro Portion' from Subway's official German PDF 'Nährwertinformationen September 2026 Deutschland' (Excel export dated 07.08.2026), linked from subway.com/de-DE as 'Nährwerte'. Per the PDF, subs/wraps/salads include the recommended bread/wrap, the protein, standard vegetables and sauce in the standard build; subs are 15 cm (Footlong = double). The PDF was read via the browser (curl is blocked) and its text extracted; values were transcribed row by row. In the drinks block the PDF's columns are shifted for sugary drinks, so only zero drinks (all values 0 or 2 kcal) are used. 'Beef Chili' salad (fibre 36 g in the source) was left out as a likely source error. 'Spicy Vegan Patty' sub was left out: its published 301 kcal contradicts its own 1473 kJ (= 352 kcal) and the macros (about 359 kcal). 'Waffle Fries' left out: 184 kcal vs 1085 kJ (= 259 kcal) in the source.
